geometry: A lavender cream-stone disc stands within rounded low ruins. Exactly two broad crystal slabs occupy opposing rear-left and front-right quarters at mirrored inward angles, leaving the horizontal combat axis and centre open. Each slab has one large readable reflective face and a solid stone base. Two small gold lamps illuminate the floor; crystal facets reflect the scene without filling the court with beams.

signatureFeature.physicalObjects: Two large faceted crystal slabs face inward at fixed opposing angles. Their broad reflective faces and solid bases remain in the same positions throughout a bout.
signatureFeature.activation: A declared reflectable energy projectile strikes a crystal face. The resident displays the fixed reflection directions before the bout.
signatureFeature.consequence: A compatible projectile changes direction once along the visible reflected path. Fighters can bank a shot around cover or bait an opponent into exposing itself to its own reflected attack.
counterplay: Leave the reflected line or attack from another angle.
Close the distance while the opponent lines up its reflected shot.
limits: Reflection preserves the declared attack cost and cannot multiply projectiles.
A shot reflects at most once; water masses, vines and body strikes do not become laser beams.
Crystal angles stay fixed; the resident cannot aim them at a chosen fighter.
visualEvidence: Eligible attack leaves a visible source.
It touches the actual crystal face.
It changes direction at that contact point and follows a continuous path.
The defender blocks, dodges or takes a visible hit.

resident.perch: Rear-right verge beside the base of a low viewing stone, away from both crystal reflection lines.

reset: Restore cover, water, feature phase and every displaced object to the same declared starting state before each bout.
